name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Doprava (Shipping / Logistics) tab
description:
## Why?

Conditional tab, rendered only when the service is a shipping service (`isShippingService`), which is why it is not visible on a normal addon. It has two mutually exclusive template branches behind the `FEATURE_LOGISTICS_GUI` flag and it is the only tab owned by a different team, so it is scoped as its own task.

## What?

Port both branches of the Doprava tab to React, remove the external-tab bridge entry and delete the legacy partials. Coordinate with logistics-team before starting: section-map row 1469 (`PartnerServiceShippingServiceDetail`) carries `serviceTeam='logistics'`.

Legacy branch `sub/ServiceDetail/Shipping.tpl`: `shippingService[externalScriptUrl]`, `shippingService[calculatePriceMethod]` (select), `shippingService[deliveryAddressFill]` (select), and per frontend language `shippingService[language][]`, `shippingService[packageUrl][]`, `shippingService[initText][]`, `shippingService[updateText][]`.

New GUI branch `sub/ServiceDetail/Logistics.tpl` (`FEATURE_LOGISTICS_GUI`): only `shippingService[language][]` and `shippingService[packageUrl][]`, plus the links into `PartnerServiceShippingServiceDetail`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Tab renders only when `isShippingService` is true
- Both `FEATURE_LOGISTICS_GUI` branches render correctly and switching the flag produces the legacy behaviour in each case
- All `shippingService[...]` field names unchanged; `saveShippingData()` round-trips values correctly, including the per-language block
- `calculatePriceMethod` and `deliveryAddressFill` selects use the same enum options as the legacy page
- Links into `PartnerServiceShippingServiceDetail` work; that controller is not modified beyond the Inertia bridge
- Every `data-testid` from both partials preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- Legacy partials deleted and bridge entry removed
- Reviewed by logistics-team
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green

## Resources

- Legacy: `admin/controllers/templates/sub/ServiceDetail/Shipping.tpl`, `sub/ServiceDetail/Logistics.tpl:20,21,33,46,47`, `admin/controllers/templates/PartnerServiceAdd.tpl:76,78`
- Backend: `admin/controllers/PartnerServiceAddController.php:1309-1345` (`saveShippingData()`), `admin/controllers/PartnerServiceShippingServiceDetailController.php`
- `cms/packages/Logistics/CmsShipping/` (`ShippingServiceRepository`, `Commands/UpdateShippingServiceCommand`), `cms/packages/Accounting/Enum/CalculatePriceMethod`, `cms/packages/Accounting/Enum/DeliveryAddressFill`
- Ownership: `/cms/packages/Logistics`, `/cms/packages/Shipping`, `/admin/controllers/Logistics` are owned by logistics-team in CODEOWNERS
- Data: `st_cms.shipping_methods`, `st_cms.shipping_methods_lng`
